meta.title: Code Ripple Background
meta.description: Drifting code-character backgrounds with switchable presets: console-style wavy ribbons (default, driven by token/s and task state), Claude ambient wind field, no background, DeepSeek whale mark, maid portraits, a rotating computing-pioneers portrait (Turing, von Neumann, Shannon), a rotating 3D globe and a static earth-continent map without Antarctica - click ripples disperse the artwork and it quickly reassembles.
